root: ^You’re back! I was starting to get worried, but I’m so glad to see you! Her face lights up as she continues, a proud smile spreading across her face.
^So, guess what I found out? The labyrinth—it was built by my great-grandmother, Kara! Can you believe it? Her excitement grows as she speaks.

^I couldn’t figure out exactly why it was built... but it had to have been for some big purpose, right? Maybe to hide something, or maybe... maybe she was hiding herself. She pauses, her expression softening just for a moment.
^I know it’s all a little overwhelming, but I just know we’re getting closer. I’m so hopeful that you’ll solve this... I’m almost living for it!
^Her eyes gleam with anticipation as she speaks. We’ll get to the bottom of this. I know we will.
